records.title: Fractionalization of minimal excitations in integer quantum Hall edge channels
records.read: Parsed Sections III.B Eqs.(19)-(22) and Appendix C coherent-state scattering; electron/hole context from Section II and IV. The displacement amplitude in Eq.(20) explicitly fixes the normalization.
records.boundary: Base model, voltage-to-coherent-state mapping, clean pulse special cases and linear scattering are inherited. Requested page6/page14 screenshots failed. No figure numbers or unrendered plot data used.

records.title: Electron and electron-hole quasiparticle states in a driven quantum contact

records.read: Parsed opening state decomposition Eq.(1), occupied/unoccupied pair decomposition and probabilities Eqs.(2)-(3), plus distinction between waveform and quasiparticle wavefunctions. Requested page1 screenshot failed.
